what_happened: BoJ announces Quantitative and Qualitative Easing under Kuroda: monetary base to double in two years. Ends when Kuroda tells the Diet (2015-06-10) the real effective rate is unlikely to fall further.

BoJ reaffirms unlimited fixed-rate JGB purchases to defend yield curve control while the Fed and ECB tighten -- the explicit divergence decision. Ends when the BoJ raises its policy rate to 0.25% and announces taper.
source_type: BoJ policy statement; MoF intervention record

what_happened: ECB cuts the deposit rate below zero for the first time; extended by the 2015-01-22 QE announcement. Ends when asset purchases actually begin.
Fed ends QE3 asset purchases, formalising the divergence with the ECB and BoJ. SAME MACRO EVENT as the EUR row above, seen from the other side.
SNB signals it will no longer act decisively against appreciation, and the franc is bid as a haven through the euro-area sovereign crisis. Ends the day the SNB imposes the 1.20 floor.
source_type: SNB policy statements; SNB floor announcement
